result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but a few elements look visually unfinished or clipped: the top-right avatar appears as an empty placeholder, and horizontally scrolling sections are cut off at the right edge without clear affordance.

issues.description: Top-right profile/avatar area shows a plain gray circle with only a red dot, looking like a missing or unloaded avatar image.
issues.suggestion: Load the user avatar or replace the empty gray circle with a clear profile icon/initials; keep the notification badge aligned and purposeful.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped at the right edge, with 'Trattoria Piccol...' cut off mid-name and the card partially off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, edge fade, peek spacing, or ensure card text truncates cleanly within visible bounds.

issues.description: The category chip row is also cut off at the right edge after 'Healthy', making the filter list look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent inset padding and a fade/arrow to indicate more categories are available, or fit chips within the viewport.

issues.description: The large green promo banner has decorative shapes that slightly crowd the right side and reduce visual balance near the CTA area.
issues.suggestion: Reduce opacity/size of background blobs or increase right-side padding so the banner content feels less compressed.
